title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Cherry Flavour Concentrate adds a rich, stone-fruit twist to the legendary Pinkman profile. This concentrate blends the signature base of sweet Red Berries (dominated by Strawberry and Raspberry with subtle Citrus undertones) with the deep, bold taste of ripe Cherry. The addition of Cherry provides a darker, sweeter depth that contrasts beautifully with the zesty Tropical hints of the original mix. It creates a well-rounded and intense fruit profile that is satisfying without being overly sharp. This 30ml bottle contains 100% PG-suspended flavour concentrate and is not ready to vape. It must be diluted with a VG/PG base mix and nicotine shots if required. For the best results, we recommend a mix ratio of 15-20% depending on your desired flavour strength. This high-quality UK-made concentrate is perfect for DIY mixers looking to customise their e-liquid. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based 0mg E-liquid Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Mix your own e-liquids, just the way you like Made in the UK
